test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Choose the most appropriate title for the passage.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Ocean Colour.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate title for the given passage is** "Ocean Colour".**
 
• The passage discusses how the colour of the oceans is changing due to climate change and how this change will affect the growth of creatures in the oceans.
 
• It also explains why we see the oceans as blue and green and what causes their colours.
 
• Therefore,** option 2) "Ocean Colour" **accurately reflects the main topic of the passage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Options 1) "Climate Change"** and **4) "Weather Conditions"** are too broad and do not focus specifically on the ocean colour.
 
• **Option 3) "Blue and Green" **is relevant to the topic, but it only refers to the colours of the oceans without mentioning the reason behind their change.
 
• Hence,** option 2)** is the most appropriate title for the passage.
